none: PAS FindID 907083: Roman coin : Republican denarius of Mark Antony
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman Republican denarius of Mark Antony dating to 32-31 BC, struck by a travelling mint. The reverse depicts a legionary eagle between two standards and the legend LEG III, for Legio 3. To the obverse is a galley, right (oars and standard placed at the prow visible) with the legend [ANT AVG] above and [III]VIR.R.P.C below. Reference: RRC 544/15.
